propositions: The retired 'recheck-review' trigger word is a substring of the external CI ChatOps 'recheck' mapping in gerrit_to_platform.ini, causing substring-based comment matchers to spuriously dispatch CI verification workflows and cancel in-flight runs.
The review-bot's own reply texts embed the retired trigger word verbatim, making the bot's posted Gerrit comments themselves sources of spurious CI dispatch.

The new trigger token 'rerun-llm-review' must contain no ini-mapped comment-added key as a substring and must not be contained as a substring in any ini key, enforced by a test that parses the ini template at runtime.

All contributor-facing documentation, guides, runbooks, and comments must be updated to reference only the new trigger word, with the retired word surviving in production code only in the detector module's regex and docstring.
